LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Novice_1: {PAWN} swept the perimeter, logged a handful of ghoul sightings, and confirmed the fence line was still holding.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Novice_2: {PAWN} tracked a raider scouting party back to their camp and reported the coordinates for follow-up.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Novice_3: {PAWN} pulled a cache of pre-War salvage out of a collapsed bunker before anyone else could find it.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Novice_4: {PAWN} spent the patrol chasing off looters who'd gotten too close to a sensor station.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Veteran_1: {PAWN} cleared a mutant nest that had been growing too close to a supply route and burned the rest for good measure.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Veteran_2: {PAWN} tracked down a cell of wasteland holdouts and brought the operation to a clean end.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the mission surveying contested ground, marking it fit for the next installation.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back with a dented breastplate and a full report on enemy movements.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Elite_1: {PAWN} went in alone where a squad would have tripped every sensor in the sector, and came out clean.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the operation exactly to spec, in, neutralize the threat, out before anyone noticed.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks off the grid and returned with data the labs have been waiting on for months.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just filed the report and requested new orders.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any territory the Enclave holds, charting ground for the next installation.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from unclaimed land with a full survey and word of a region ready to fall under Enclave control.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks beyond contact and returned with intelligence the President will want to hear personally.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Enclave_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back through the checkpoint carrying proof of what was found at the edge of the map, dust and scorched metal in equal measure.
